subject: West gable beside the east edge of the public mouth of Hefei Road Lane 592
authority: City register 5A056 covers Hefei Road Lane 592. The immediately east-facing street entries are independently numbered 590 and 586. The three side apertures are visible boundary architecture. No interior dwelling assignment follows from them.
window_plane: West wall X=0, X towards east, Y north into lane, Z above lane in metres
control_precision: Estimated. Local upper jamb corners repeat with typically a few pixels and up to about 10 px where branches or swung leaves obscure the edge. The two photographed aperture heights may include local rectification differences. The ground opening has one clear independent lower corner in 2017 and 2019.
shutter_state: Both upper openings show the pale weathered reverse of the back leaf swung towards the lane, a dark inside sash and a reddish front leaf over the streetward half. The lowest pair are both red and shut. September 2017 shows the upper streetward pair shut; the model depicts February 2015.
leaf_reconstruction: The two partly folded leaves are estimated from their projected tips. February 2015 streetward upper leaf admits roughly 95–140 degrees and the further upper leaf approximately 115–160 degrees of rotation. The recessed sash and shutter thickness lack a direct survey.
louver_measure: In the closer rendering of the original street panorama, two intensity strips on the ground pair have a dominant period of 6.0 screen pixels. The slatted field spans about 156 screen pixels, suggesting 26 repeated blades. Upper counts are scaled to the measured aperture and the visible division between the solid head and slatted field; individual historic counts are estimated.
